Requires 1 initial all-reduce (full data) + 7 metadata all-reduces (8 scalars each) + 1 final all-reduce (full data). Total 9 dispatches but 7 have tiny payloads, reducing total bandwidth at the cost of more dispatch overhead.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-phase reduction with early aggregation
strategies.desc: Divide the 8 blocks into 2 groups of 4, perform 4 dependent all-reduce cycles on group-1 data while keeping group-2 data pending, then perform 4 cycles on group-2, finally merge. Alternatively, perform pairs of iterations simultaneously on disjoint block subsets. Expected 8-9 dispatches but with smaller per-dispatch payloads (half-size buffers). Trades memory layout complexity for reduced network congestion per operation.
